Please check the below code...

server.R

library(shiny)
shinyServer(function(input, output)

{
  data <- reactive({
    if (input$header== TRUE)
    {
      infile <- input$file1
      if (is.null(input$file1)) {return(NULL)}
      risk <- read.csv(infile$datapath)
    } 
    else 
    {        
      infile <- input$file1
      if (is.null(input$file1)) {return(NULL)}
      tmp <- strsplit(input$value,",")[[1]]
      risk <- read.csv(infile$datapath,header=FALSE,col.names=tmp)
    }
  })
  output$datam <- renderTable({data()})
  output$head <- renderTable({head(data())})

output$summary <- renderTable({summary(data())})
   
  output$variables <- renderUI(
    {
      numsa <- as.list(names(data()[sapply(data(), is.numeric)]))
      selectInput('select','Select Here',numsa)

hist(datam[,input$select]) 
  
})
